# `silk/concurrency/execution_storage`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Storage for the private execution frames that the compiler makes.

## When to use
The compiler and the runtime use this module through its C exports. Application code does not
call it.

## Details
Each [`ExecutionStorage`](#ExecutionStorage) state owns its limit, its accounting and its reservations. There is no
shared counter and no environment lookup. Allocation and release use the declared allocator of
the selected target.

## Errors
[`ExecutionStorage.make`](#ExecutionStorage.impl.make) fails with `OutOfMemoryError`. [`ExecutionStorage.acquire`](#ExecutionStorage.impl.acquire) returns
null when a frame does not fit in the limit or cannot be allocated.

## Gotchas
- Raw frame access is unsafe. A frame is valid only until it is released or its state is
  destroyed.
- One state needs exclusive use. Independent states can use a concurrent host allocator.

Import as `ExecutionStorage` with `import silk.concurrency.execution_storage { ExecutionStorage }`.

Public declarations: 1.

<a id="ExecutionStorage.impl.make"></a>

### Associated function `make`

```silk
pub effect fn make(limit: usize) -> ExecutionStorage ! OutOfMemoryError
```

Creates an independent state whose frame reservations can charge at most `limit` bytes.

#### Details

Charges include each reservation header and alignment padding. The fixed state allocation
is excluded. Refusal acquires no state and reports OutOfMemoryError.

<a id="ExecutionStorage.impl.used"></a>

### Method `used`

```silk
pub fn used(self: &ExecutionStorage) -> usize
```

Returns the bytes charged to this state's current frame reservations.

<a id="ExecutionStorage.impl.acquire"></a>

### Method `acquire`

```silk
pub unsafe fn acquire(self: &mut ExecutionStorage, size: usize, alignment: usize) -> ?*mut u8
```

Acquires a fixed-address frame or returns null without retaining a partial reservation.

#### Gotchas

The caller must initialize bytes before reading, obey the requested extent, and stop using
the pointer before release or state destruction. A zero size or invalid alignment returns
null.

<a id="ExecutionStorage.impl.release"></a>

### Method `release`

```silk
pub unsafe fn release(self: &mut ExecutionStorage, frame: ?*mut u8) -> ()
```

Releases one frame acquired from this state and removes its charge.

#### Gotchas

The caller must finish semantic cleanup and stop every access before releasing the frame.
